messages:
migrator-bot: Planned schema migration 'orders_add_shard_key' scheduled 2026-02-12 02:00-02:30 UTC. Backfill + index add. Estimated rows: 12M. Rate cap: 5k rows/min by default. Will attempt prefix KV cache. Please ack and pin services. Rollback plan: revert index, cancel backfill.
anya: Ack. Quick question — can we add a soft holdpoint at 02:05? last night we saw a latency bump. :eyes:
kevin_db: SGTM. Add tourniquet and early abort threshold at 30% replica lag. SQL snippet for the index add will be run with online flag:
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN shard_id int DEFAULT 0;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_shard ON orders(shard_id);
```
kevin_db: Backfill command (example): `./backfill --table orders --col shard_id --rate 5000 --checkpoint 5m`
sam_release: I'm going to pin order-api so no autoscale deploys during the window. /deploybot pin order-api v3.1.2 --until 02:45UTC
deploybot: Deploybot: order-api pinned to v3.1.2 until 2026-02-12T02:45:00Z by sam_release. :white_check_mark:
olga: Oncall note: I'll be watching PG replica lag and p99 latency. If lag > 20s or p99 > 300ms we abort. Who is on rollback? @kevin_db and @olga?
oncall-sre: I'm on pager. If we need to abort, use `deploybot abort-migration <id>` and then post to #incidents.
anya: small ask — can we delay start to 02:10 instead of 02:00 to give infra a bit more time? otherwise fine.
kevin_db: fine with 02:10 start. I'll add a 10m preflight check (row-count sanity + slow query sampling).
migrator-bot: Updated schedule to start 02:10 UTC. Migration id: mig-20260212-07. Preflight checklist attached in gist: https://gist.redwood/mig-20260212-07/preflight.
sam_release: Noted. Release notes snippet for the change: "Add shard_id to orders to enable future partitioning; online backfill with rate limiting; no functional change." I'll append to the release docs.
olga: adding a short runbook in case of abort: steps 1) run `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260212-07` 2) revert index creation 3) scale down worker batchers 4) open incident channel.
kevin_db: one more: enable the tourniquet flag if backfill falls behind >3 checkpoints. Command: `./backfill --tourniquet --tourniquet-threshold 3`
sam_release: all acked from release side. I'll leave pin until 02:45 and remove after we confirm post-migration sanity. :thumbsup:
anya: thanks all — will be on the thread during the window for quick approvals.
oncall-sre: I'll post a final preflight pass at 02:05 UTC and then give the greenlight.
